trials.title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Immunogenicity of COVID-19 Vaccine and Influenza Combination Vaccine
interventions: CIC Vaccine Co-formulated tNIV2 , SARSCoV-2 rS and Matrix-M Adjuvant

primaryOutcomes.measure: Numbers of participants with solicited local and systemic adverse events (AEs)
Numbers of participants reporting unsolicited AEs and medically attended adverse events (MAAEs).

Treatment-related MAAEs, serious adverse events (SAEs), and adverse events of special interest (AESIs) (including potential immune-mediated medical conditions [PIMMCs] and myocarditis and/or pericarditis)
Hemagglutination Inhibition (HAI) antibody responses of the CIC vaccine compared to Fluzone High-Dose of homologous A and B strains Expressed as GMT
Hemagglutination Inhibition (HAI) antibody responses of the CIC vaccine compared to Fluzone High-Dose of homologous A and B strains Expressed as GMTR
Percentage of Participants With a (HAI) antibody responses of the CIC vaccine compared to Fluzone High-Dose for 3 vaccine-homologous influenza strains Expressed as SCR

reasons: one of only 1 trials at this company

signals.text: Primary completion pushed out 9 months vs original registration (Mar 2024): Mar 2025 to Dec 2025 (3 moves on record)
signals.read: Moderate delay. One slip is common; repeated slips are the signal.
Over-delivered on enrollment. Strong investigator and patient demand, or cohorts were expanded after an early signal.

trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized. Enrolled 9,320 vs 4,000 at registration (+133%). Started Dec 2024 (planned Aug 2024), primary completion Dec 2025 vs Mar 2025 at registration (+9 mo, 3 moves); planned 0.5 yrs, now 1.0 yrs.
